question.problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n}{2}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n}{2}x)
$$

The Fourier series of the $4\pi $-periodic extension $f(x)$ of the function 

$$
F(x)=\{\begin{aligned}5, & x\in [0,2\pi ) \\ -2, & x\in [-2\pi ,0)\end{aligned}
$$

is shown above. Find the exact value of ${b}_{3}.$

${b}_{3}=$ {{field-1}}

current_example.problem:
$$
f(x) \sim \dfrac{a_0}{2}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_n\cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi}{2}x\right)+b_n\sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi}{2}x\right)
$$

Let $F(x)=-5x+4$ for $x\in[-2,2).$ The Fourier series of the $4$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of $a_3.$
current_example.worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the cosine coefficients are given by

$$
a_n=\frac{1}{L}\int_{-L}^{L} f(x)\cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi}{L}x\right)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=2$ and $f(x)=-5x+4$ for $x \in [-2,2).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
a_3 = \dfrac{1}{2}\int_{-2}^{2} (-5x+4)\cos\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}x\right)\,\text{d}x.
$$

We use the integration by parts: 

$$
\begin{aligned}u=-5x+4\, & ⇒\,{u}^{′}=-5 \\ {v}^{′}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\, & ⇒\,v=\frac{2}{3\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{3} & =\frac{1}{2}(uv\,{|}_{-2}^{2}-{\int }_{-2}^{2}v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(\frac{2}{3\pi }{[(-5x+4)\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)]}_{-2}^{2}-{\int }_{-2}^{2}\frac{2}{3\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\cdot (-5)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(\frac{2}{3\pi }[(-5(2)+4)\operatorname{sin}⁡(3\pi )-(-5(-2)+4)\operatorname{sin}⁡(-3\pi )]+\frac{10}{3\pi }{\int }_{-2}^{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(\frac{2}{3\pi }\cdot 0+\frac{10}{3\pi }\cdot (-\frac{2}{3\pi }){[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)]}_{-2}^{2}) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(-\frac{20}{9{\pi }^{2}}[\operatorname{cos}⁡(3\pi )-\operatorname{cos}⁡(-3\pi )]) \\  & =-\frac{10}{9{\pi }^{2}}(-1-(-1)) \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
